kurz: Crisp skin and juicy meat at once: the skin needs dryness and heat, the breast must not get too hot.
bild_im_kopf: Like a coat and its wearer: the coat should be dry and crisp, the wearer warm but not sweaty.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Salt all over the day before and store uncovered in the fridge
schluesselmomente.warum: The salt seasons right through and keeps juice in the meat; the skin dries in the air.
Dry heat renders the fat in the skin and browns the surface.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Check with a thermometer: breast at least 70 °C, leg better at 75–80 °C
schluesselmomente.warum: The leg has more connective tissue and gets more tender with a little more heat; too much makes the breast dry.
The juices redistribute in the meat and run out less when carving.
